name: Listening to the Bamboo
material: hanging scroll, ink on sutra paper

summary: Listening to the Bamboo (聽竹圖), late 1400s-1500s. Imitator of Wen Zhengming (Chinese, 1470–1559). Hanna Jr. Fund, 1977.172
